title: DeviceError
description: Unsolicited uplink error. Used for faults that cannot be reported in an ack, such as a line that is not valid JSON or a sensor that stopped responding. A command that parsed but cannot be executed is answered with an ack with status rejected instead.

message.description: Short English description, at most 120 characters.

ref_seq.description: Downlink seq the error refers to, null when unknown.

cmd_id.description: Downlink cmd_id the error refers to, null when unknown.

DeviceErrorCode.title: DeviceErrorCode
DeviceErrorCode.description: parse_error means the line is not valid JSON, line_too_long means it exceeded 512 bytes, sensor_fault and actuator_fault mean hardware stopped responding, queue_full means a line was dropped, internal is anything else.
